instruction: Understood, I think we'll have to address that as we naturally rerun benches with new models, new skills, etc. Otherwise I think it might be too expensive. Maybe we can later rerun some of the benches that use cheaper models or if we have excess usage before a token reset.
decision: Defer blanket rerunning of legacy-workspace grading. Retain earlier results with an explicit blinding qualification. Future grading uses verified neutral workspaces.
laterOptions: Natural benchmark runs with new models or skills
Selected reruns when spare usage is available before reset
publication: No website registry or score release is changed by this decision. Reference and release audit remain separate.
